description: Window cleaning in Bella Colinas, Bee Cave. Pure water glass for 2010s homes zoned to Bee Cave schools, from $10 a window, with plans that save 10% to 20%.
intro: Bella Colinas is a Bee Cave subdivision of about 300 homes from the 2010s, zoned for Bee Cave schools. CleanzATX cleans windows here for families who would rather spend Saturday somewhere else.

sections.h2: What Bella Colinas homes are like
paragraphs: Bella Colinas is a 2010s neighborhood of roughly 300 homes in Bee Cave, with houses from about 1,900 to 6,000 square feet and prices from the high $500,000s to $1.1 million. Families come for the Bee Cave schools, and the Bella Colinas HOA keeps streets and common areas in order. There is no gate. It is a busy family neighborhood, with kids, dogs and basketball goals in driveways.
Houses are stucco and stone, with two story plans that put windows high above the front door and over the garage.

sections.h2: What Bella Colinas windows deal with
paragraphs: Family life leaves marks on glass inside, fingerprints and nose prints at toddler height, and those are cleaned by hand with squeegees. Outside, sprinklers spot the ground floor windows, Bee Cave construction dust drifts in, and pollen arrives twice, cedar from December to February and oak in March and April. Trees planted along the street are growing up and bringing webs.

Second story glass is where most owners give up, since ladders on stucco are risky. Our poles reach three stories from the ground, so the upper windows get the same pure water rinse as the lower ones. Stucco and stone walls are soft washed, never pressure washed.

We keep around school hours and ask about dogs in the yard ahead of time. Many homes here have window screens that need a clean, which is $5 each, and screens with the first visit make a difference. We often pair Bella Colinas with Terra Colinas, which sits close by. Plans suit busy families: Twice a Year saves 10%, and Triannual saves 15%, so the glass gets done before you remember it.
For a 3,200 square foot home, exterior windows run about $320, in roughly two and a half to three hours. Add the interior and the total is close to $480.

faq.q: Can you clean the second story windows?

faq.q: Will you work around my dogs?
faq.a: Tell us about them in your text. We keep gates latched, and we ask that dogs be inside while we work in the yard.

faq.q: What does the interior cleaning include?
faq.a: Windows are hand cleaned with squeegees, with drop cloths down on the floor. The inside is added at $15 a window.
The discounts start at 10% for Twice a Year and climb to 20% for Every 2 Months. We schedule the visits so you do not have to remember.
Outside takes about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 square feet, and inside about 30 minutes per 1,000. A 3,200 square foot home is a half day or less.
